Privacy

Textbound Adventures is designed without accounts, advertising, or third-party tracking.

The game

Textbound Adventures does not require you to create an account. It does not show ads or use your activity to build an advertising profile.

This website

This is a static website. It has no forms, analytics, tracking pixels, or third-party scripts, and it does not set first-party cookies.

Information you choose to share

If you voluntarily send a support report through an Apple service such as TestFlight, that service may include diagnostic information according to your settings and Apple’s policies. Only share what you are comfortable providing.

Questions

Current support information is kept on the support page. This notice will be updated if the game or website begins handling information differently.
